text:
rachel.marketing: Quick heads-up 1:00 PT launch push for the new benchmark summary. Small change: we swapped the hero image last-minute. Please stand by for asset refresh.

olivia.pr: Noted. Any quote edits? Need final CEO line for the press email.

mike.eng: No quote changes. We did update the latency table to include the new quantized model; it's in the assets folder.

tara.analytics: I validated the numbers. New hero doesn't affect metrics. Uploaded final PNGs (hero + social variants) to the drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/bench-assets-2145

rachel.marketing: Great. I'll swap assets on the CMS at T-5 and schedule the social posts. @pressbot will still send embargo lifts at 21:00 PT.

pressbot: [automated] Scheduled: embargo lift + press outreach at 21:00 PT to 18 reporters.

support.lead: Support ready. I'll open #support-bench-launch and post a 1-pager FAQ at publish. Expect minor traffic spike.

olivia.pr: Draft email is ready. CEO line: "Redwood Inference continues to prioritize predictable, production-grade performance for real workloads." Approve?

mike.eng: Approve.

rachel.marketing: CMS swap done. Assets updated. Going to schedule the publish.

pressbot: [automated] Sending embargo lift in 60 seconds.

rachel.marketing: We're live 1:00 PT. Blog URL: https://blog.redwood.ai/2026/bench-summary-launch. Press emails sent. Please monitor channel for any incoming requests.

olivia.pr: First inbound from CloudWeek. I'll route technical asks to @mike.eng.

tara.analytics: Traffic looks healthy. No errors. Pulling initial view metrics.

support.lead: Small uptick in help center hits, triage staffed.

rachel.marketing: Thanks team. Quick debrief scheduled tomorrow 10am PT to capture any follow-ups and update the playbook.

pressbot: [automated] Summary: 18 emails sent, 9 opens in first 10 minutes, 3 replies requesting follow-ups.
